title: Basic English Greetings
content: Common greetings include Hello, Hi, Good morning, and Good evening. To introduce yourself, say My name is and ask And you?

title: Present Simple
content: Use the present simple for habits and routines. Example: I practice English every day. For he or she, add s: She practices English.

title: Common Grammar Mistakes
content: Common mistakes include missing articles. Use a before consonant sounds and an before vowel sounds. Use the for something specific.

title: Daily Conversation Tips
content: Keep daily conversations short and clear. Answer with one idea, then ask one follow-up question. Practice topics like school, work, food, and hobbies.

title: Pronunciation Advice
content: Speak slowly and stress important words. Listen and repeat short phrases. Focus on clear endings like ed and s rather than a perfect accent.

title: Vocabulary Building
content: Learn words in short phrases, not alone. Review 3 to 5 new words daily and use each word in one spoken sentence.

title: Confidence Speaking Tips
content: Confidence grows with small practice. Make mistakes calmly, restart the sentence, and celebrate short wins after each conversation.
